items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: that 1955 Jazz at the Philharmonic tour, with Ella, you went to Paris.

ctx.x: And even on a personal level, she was withdrawn a lot and on her own pretty much. And then of course she was swayed by a lot of different men who just seized the opportunity to latch on to somebody famous instead of really taking care of her.

Well something interesting happened that, well I don’t know if you’d describe it as interesting, but that 1955 Jazz at the Philharmonic tour, with Ella, you went to Paris. And you did not have a very warm reception…
